description: This file defines a utility class 'DistPubSubAccess' that provides static methods to create various messages for interacting with Akka's DistributedPubSubMediator, such as publishing, subscribing, unsubscribing, and sending messages to actor references within a clustered pub/sub environment.

classes.name: DistPubSubAccess
classes.description: Helper utility class providing static methods to create pub/sub messages for Akka's DistributedPubSubMediator.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Creates a publish message for a given topic and message.

methods.name: publishViaGroup
methods.description: Creates a publish message targeting a group on a specific topic with a grouped suffix.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a subscription message for a subscriber ActorRef on a specific topic.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Creates an unsubscription message for a subscriber ActorRef on a specific topic.

methods.name: subscribeViaGroup
methods.description: Creates a subscription message for a subscriber ActorRef on a group topic with suffix.

methods.name: unsubscribeViaGroup
methods.description: Creates an unsubscription to a group topic message for a subscriber ActorRef.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Registers an ActorRef on the pub/sub system for later messaging.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific ActorRef identified by its path.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific ActorRef, with optional local affinity preference.

methods.name: sendToAll
methods.description: Sends a message to all ActorRefs at a specified path.

methods.name: sendToAll
methods.description: Sends a message to all ActorRefs at a specified path, with option to exclude self.
